source_text: Oculum pro oculo lex dixit; evangelium maxillam praebet. Littera severa; spiritus misericors. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Eye for eye law said; gospel cheek offers. Letter severe; spirit merciful. Amen.
pass_b_english: The law said [[eye for eye >> Bible:Leviticus 24:20]]; the gospel offers the cheek. Severe letter; merciful Spirit. Homilia XIV CLOSEOUT. Amen.
